normalization: fixed physical time; count/10; gaps log1p(gap/0.02), rank/32; no evaluation fitting
calibration_and_power: Independent fresh banks, 100 trials/cell; queued after complete burn/cost stages, fail closed unless all ten methods pass and full-suite cost <=60 seconds. No inference from repeated resampling of one bank.
selection: All bandwidths/scales fixed in advance; no hyperparameter selection on evaluation
future_confirmatory_family: Freeze selected burn and feasible method family in a new plan before fresh H0/H1 evaluation; separate calibration namespace.
ksd: Not applicable to hidden-burn Hawkes with the current empty-past density adapter; no oracle-size claim for a misspecified target
rmse: Common fixed empty-past exponential Hawkes working predictor; pair-swap test, not exact oracle conditional prediction with hidden burn
stationarity: Finite-start cluster generation; empirical stabilization and kernel tail mass are diagnostics, not an exact stationarity guarantee
